name: bhorsha
description: Bhorsha (ভরসা): evidence-labelled viability files and a forecasting watchman for small-business lending. Synthetic demo data only.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.train: npm run cohort -w server && python ml/train.py
scripts.eval: npm run cohort -w server && python ml/train.py --eval-only && npm run eval -w server
